extraction.Name: Martha Guerue (Richards)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by C. L. Dice on February 14, 1918
extraction.Buyer: Martha Guerue Richards and Samuel Richards conveyed the land to Diener and Rock Company for $2500.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612694 issued; southeast quarter of section 4, township 35, range 32; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 6, 1918; deed dated February 9, 1918
